So, by getting the better seats, you're already getting the reward, and whether you "deserve" it or not might not be the right way to look at it. Another thought is about the value of hard work. If I believe that hard work should be rewarded, then yes, I deserve a fun time. In summary, I'm weighing whether the effort I put in entitles me to a fun time, or if the fun time is simply a result of that effort. It seems like both perspectives have merit, and it might come down to personal belief about what "deserving" means in this context.
